title: avena elatior var. sardoa
intro: Avena elatior var. sardoa, commonly known as Sardinian oat, is a variety of oat plant native to Sardinia. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Sardinian oat include sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as avenacosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents may also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
